title: Rav Sama son of Rav Mari

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 62b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.62b.18), where Rav Chana bar Ada speaks in his name.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked passage, Rav Chana bar Ada cites Rav Sama son of Rav Mari about the word kappandarya, “shortcut.” [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2804&lang=en) records the same transmission.
